$comment: The recorded captures the app offers, newest configuration last. Written by scripts/capture-config.mjs; hand-editable. Everything here is redacted — no host, no screen names.

captures.label: Base — four screens, no layers on VPU 1
captures.summary: All 16 mixers of VPU 1 are native backgrounds. The staged mapping differs from the running one, so this is the capture that exercises the diff.

captures.label: Six-output screen + a 5K layer
captures.summary: The manual's §5.5.4 figure: S1 owns output links 1-6 and each of its layers covers 1-4 then wraps onto 5-6. S2's native is 5K, four layer links tall. VPU 1 is exactly 8/8 both ways.

captures.label: Optimized mode
captures.summary: S1 reports isOptimized, so the centre-line boundary is lifted for its capacity-2 layers and their bars run unbroken. The only capture carrying screenStatus, and so the device's own headroom figures.
